# The war in the west is won: the Anglo-American peace, or Germany's Totaler
# Sieg. The Vichy tree's post-war half opens; its wartime half closes.
wif_vic_west_won = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = wif_vic_west_won_tt
		OR = {
			has_global_flag = wif_anglo_american_peace
			any_country = {
				original_tag = GER
				has_completed_focus = GER_totaler_sieg
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_vic_war_in_the_west = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = wif_vic_war_in_the_west_tt
		NOT = { has_global_flag = wif_anglo_american_peace }
		NOT = {
			any_country = {
				original_tag = GER
				has_completed_focus = GER_totaler_sieg
			}
		}
	}
}

# COUNTRY scope: a French state on the Reich's side - Vichy, by whatever tag
# it has. On the La Resistance path Vichy is a dynamic country with
# original_tag FRA; on the others it may be FRA itself.
wif_cw_is_reich_vichy = {
	exists = yes
	original_tag = FRA
	is_government_in_exile = no
	OR = {
		has_country_flag = vichy_france
		has_cosmetic_tag = FRA_VICHY
		AND = {
			is_subject = yes
			OVERLORD = { wif_cw_is_german_power = yes }
		}
		any_country = {
			wif_cw_is_german_power = yes
			is_in_faction_with = PREV
		}
	}
}
